How it works

Three steps to your team kit.

  1. 01

    Choose your style

    Pick the pieces and colorways your group wants from the Team Shop range below.

  2. 02

    Add your logo

    Upload your artwork on the product page. Each piece has a set placement, so there's no guesswork.

  3. 03

    Approve your proof

    You get a digital proof with placement, size and colors before anything runs. Your artwork stays on file for reorders.

The movement

Goal Five isn't a brand name. It's the fifth goal.

"Achieve equality and empower all women and girls."United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 5

We took our name from it because it's the whole job. Goal Five puts females first. We exist to celebrate her, because the game needs her greatness.

Why Goal Five

Designed by her, for her. Now made for your team.

Group gear shouldn't mean compromising on fit. Goal Five apparel was built specifically for female athletes.

Fit

Not a sized-down men's piece. Most team gear starts as a unisex block and shrinks. Ours starts with her body, her sport and the way she actually moves.

Wear

Premium performance fabric she'll pull on long after the season, the race or the event, so your logo keeps showing up.

Range

Shorts, tanks, quarter-zips, joggers. Mix styles across your group and it still reads as one kit.

Terms

Wholesale and group pricing, low minimums, select colorways approved for embellishment.

Who it's for

If she plays, trains, or shows up with your people.

Chapters, club teams, run crews, studios, staff. If there's a group and a logo, there's a Team Shop order.

Sororities + chapters

Your letters on gear she keeps.

Bid day, recruitment, philanthropy, intramurals. One look that isn't another cotton tee.

Volleyball + rec leagues

Team gear designed for the women playing.

Practice kits, travel gear and warm-ups that fit the roster you actually have.

Soccer clubs

Training and off-pitch pieces that carry your crest as well as your kit does.

Run clubs

Gear for the whole crew.

A race-day look the crew reaches for on every ordinary Tuesday too.
